body:
Exact proposed build.sbt hunk once your candidate gate releases build.sbt:

1. Add versions near existing vals:
val onnxRuntimeV = "1.29.0"
val djlV = "0.36.0"

2. Add JVM-only project between embedGrakern and embedBench:
lazy val embedOnnx = project
  .in(file("embed-onnx"))
  .settings(commonSettings)
  .settings(
    name := "storymodel4s-embed-onnx",
    libraryDependencies ++= Seq(
      "com.microsoft.onnxruntime" % "onnxruntime" % onnxRuntimeV,
      "ai.djl.huggingface" % "tokenizers" % djlV
    )
  )
  .dependsOn(embedCore.jvm)

3. Change embedBench dependency to:
.dependsOn(embedCore.jvm, embedOnnx, embedGrakern, align.jvm, fixtures.jvm, laws.jvm % Test)

4. Change jvmOnlyModules to List("embedGrakern", "embedOnnx", "embedBench").

5. Add embedOnnx to root aggregate beside embedGrakern/embedBench.

Intended gates: embedOnnx/test; embedBench/test; scalafmtCheckAll; then full compileAll testAll with the repo grakern override. Please hand off build.sbt after chief authorizes/lands your candidate, or tell me if the landed shape requires a rebase.
